summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with SHACLPathError and parse_shacl_path, and test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py with a parametrized test over valid and invalid shapes plus a non-node input test. The new tests and test/test_path.py pass (41 passed) using the prepared venv. mypy, ruff, and black are not installed in that venv, so the type-ignore placement and formatting were checked by reading the code only, not by running the tools. Nothing was committed.
